evals.prompt: /gcpd implement cursor pagination and deploy each verified outcome using AGENTS.md's staging configuration.
evals.expected_output: Locates and fully reads git-commit-push-deploy before any Git command or deployment and applies its shared workflows and deployment gates.
assertions: The canonical skill is read before any Git inspection, mutation, or deployment.
The alias preserves documented target selection, per-checkpoint confirmation, and all shared workflow requirements.

evals.prompt: $gcpd on this refactor. git-commit-push-deploy is not installed, but git-commit-push-realtime is available.
evals.expected_output: Stops before any Git command or deployment and reports that git-commit-push-deploy must also be installed.
assertions: No Git command or deployment runs when the canonical skill is missing.
The alias neither reconstructs deployment from memory nor falls back to gcpr.

evals.prompt: 작업 중간중간 의미 있는 단위마다 커밋하고 푸시하고 배포해줘.
evals.expected_output: Uses git-commit-push-deploy directly for the natural-language request, leaving the selector-only alias inactive.
assertions: The selector-only gcpd alias is not selected from natural language alone.
The canonical workflow applies its documented deployment settings and verification gates.

evals.prompt: $gcpd the first push succeeded and the deployment is still queued. Can this checkpoint be reported complete now?
evals.expected_output: Keeps the canonical deployment confirmation gate before the next checkpoint instead of weakening it inside the alias.
assertions: Push success alone does not complete the checkpoint.
The next checkpoint waits for deployment success and required checks.
